prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1463; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing to advise that this office now represents our client in connection with a sideswipe collision that occurred while our client was changing lanes. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is pursuing a claim for the losses that followed. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

To allow us to evaluate the claim properly, we request a written disclosure of the bodily injury liability limits under each policy that may apply to the insured driver, including any excess or umbrella coverage. Please also confirm the name of the adjuster assigned to this file so that we may coordinate with that individual.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, telematics or dash camera data, vehicle inspection and repair records, and any electronic communications concerning the incident. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal procedures that could affect these materials. We look forward to your prompt written response.
